Name: Renew and deploy wildcard SSL certificate
Description: Ben is responsible for renewing the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com before September 1st, with a target completion date of August 22nd to ensure a buffer. He must also deploy the renewed certificate to the load balancers and set up auto-renewal using cert-manager to prevent manual renewals in the future. Additionally, Ben must rotate the internal CA certificate that signs the service mesh at the same time, as it expires two weeks after the public certificate.

Name: Implement PDF export feature for reports
Description: Aisha is tasked with developing the PDF export feature for reports by the end of the month. This single deliverable includes two components: backend rendering of reports to PDF using headless Chrome, and frontend integration of an export button with a progress state to accommodate large reports. Additionally, upon completion, Aisha will record a short demo GIF of the feature for marketing to use in the changelog. This demo recording is part of the same task.

Name: Ensure staging environment parity with production
Description: Ben will address the staging environment drift by executing the three pending migrations today to bring staging up to date with production. Furthermore, he will create a nightly job that compares the staging schema against production and posts alerts to the infra channel if any divergence is detected. Both parts together constitute the staging parity task.
